description: Upload a file into a space (optionally into a folder) from an https URL or base64. Allowed: images (png, jpeg, gif, webp, heic), pdf, txt, md, csv, json, zip, docx, xlsx, pptx. Returns the file id and a download link. To attach a file to a task use attach_file_to_task.

base64.description: File content as base64 (max 5 MB), with or without a data: prefix. Give sourceUrl or base64, not both.

fileName.description: File name incl. extension, e.g. screenshot.png. Required with base64.

mimeType.description: e.g. image/png; detected from the content or extension when left out

sourceUrl.description: Public https URL the server downloads the file from (max 10 MB). Private and internal addresses are refused.

spaceId.description: Project id or chat id; not needed for private

spaceType.description: private = your own files, project = files of a project, chat = files of a chat

name: upload_file
title: Upload file
